eyebrow: SOQL & Salesforce Data Management · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 12 · Relationship Queries

code:
SELECT Name, Account.Name
FROM Contact

No subquery. No parentheses.
Just ParentRelationship.Field
caption: The parent's field flattens right into the child's own row.

eyebrow: Why it's simpler: one parent, not many
code:
One Contact -> exactly one Account
(single lookup / master-detail field)

Nothing to nest -- just more
fields on the same row
caption: Parent-to-child needed a list per row. This never does.

eyebrow: Works in WHERE too, and with custom relationships
code:
SELECT Name, Account.Industry
FROM Contact
WHERE Account.Industry = 'Technology'

Custom: Account__r.Name
(field itself is Account__c)
caption: __c stores the relationship; __r traverses it.

subtitle: How far up the chain you're actually allowed to go.
